This API endpoint retrieves the current synchronization status between Grafana and LDAP (Lightweight Directory Access Protocol) servers. It is an administrative GET operation that returns information about the last LDAP sync operation, including whether it was successful, when it occurred, and any relevant error messages or warnings. This endpoint is typically used by system administrators to monitor and troubleshoot LDAP integration, ensuring that user accounts and permissions are properly sync

This API operation retrieves the current status of LDAP integration in Grafana by sending a GET request to the /admin/ldap/status endpoint.
